description.value:
You overwhelm a creature's senses with a barrage of different emojis, each eliciting a different sensation, memory, or otherwise deeply rooted connection that causes their brain to overload with information. The creature takes 6d6 mental damage and must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Dazzled] until the start of your next turn.

Failure The creature takes full damage plus an additional @Damage[(@item.level - 3)d6[persistent,mental]] damage. While taking this persistent damage, the creature is dazzled and can only speak in emojis. While speaking in only emojis, the creature can't cast spells or use auditory and sonic effects, except those that have "emoji" or "moji" in their name or the subtle trait. The creature can still communicate by speaking, but doing so loses the auditory trait and gains the visual trait.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature takes double damage, and the creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Blinded] while taking the persistent damage. When it loses the persistent damage, it becomes dazzled until the end of its next turn.

Heightened (+1) The mental damage increases by 2d6, and the persistent mental damage increases by 1d6.
